entries.reason: Second-pass upgrade (2026-07-26): Logo remains held: ASU's brand guide explicitly restricts logo use to university faculty/staff/units conducting university business, and no Commons alternative exists (checked -- the ASU seal and logo files on Wikipedia are non-free/fair-use, not PD-textlogo, so unlike some peer universities there is no free equivalent). That restriction is specific to the logo mark, not plain campus photography, so a campus aerial photo with no branding in frame is nominated for cover only.. Remaining outstanding: logo.
